notes.title: Devlog #4 - Lydian
notes.notes:
Welcome back from the summer break! Let’s chill out and explore the new biome! 🤖

In our fourth devlog, we invite you to explore the tranquil and welcoming Lydian. This serene biome embodies benevolence and fullness, offering a sanctuary of protection and calm amidst its snowy expanse ❄️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/713511d9f15e733b3d7f680b063288a3f99e280f.png[/img]
For Lydian, we've chosen the soothing tones of the musical mode, played on the harp, to evoke a sense of hope, wonder, and gentle adventure 🎶

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/93447409c32315feed5e44d21901b253090f1399.png[/img]
Lydian's landscape is a gentle slope, from sparse forests and tranquil taigas in the west to the majestic glaciers and vistas in the east. Enclosed by towering mountains, icy cliffs, and the ocean, this biome is a haven of beauty and tranquility. The snowy plateaus and tiered natural pools around colorful geysers create a landscape of peaceful discovery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/81e9e094c81ed57e700a27b6d9c0fcb483b183b2.png[/img]
In the midst of this serene environment, the Lydian’s flora survives, with rounded and elegant plants inspired by the biome's unique elements like sulfur chimneys and geysers, bringing color and life to the snowy expanse.Their warm hues stand out against the snow, adding to the welcoming atmosphere ☃️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/5f50181a1b5292ba7fe5b5c3e77e0ea849d67e83.png[/img]
The color palette of Lydian features light blues, whites, and grays, accented by splashes of yellow and orange around the hot springs. Bathed in the soft light of a winter morning, the landscape exudes a crisp but gentle cold, inviting exploration and awe 🌟

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/60faee056a9494ad4cc1003b0a0802ab4cf5e0b6.png[/img]
Among the notable landmarks, you'll find remnants of a bygone era, such as a cold yet cozy metal igloo bunker, reflecting a blend of meticulous craftsmanship and homely comfort. The igloo, with its tricolor stripe and antennas, stands as a testament to human resilience in this tranquil wilderness.

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to unravel the mysteries of the biomes.

Before we sign off, let’s reveal the solution to our last blind test. The mysterious melody was [spoiler]The Lord of the Rings - The One Ring Theme[/spoiler]. 
Now, get ready for a new challenge with our latest blind test.

[previewyoutube=EZPXYm-fL_A;full][/previewyoutube]

Until next time, Meloamis!

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Phrygian
notes.notes:
Greetings, Meloamis! 🤖 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/733753452651ffc519719b3cc4acf1a23c93aca3.png[/img]
Welcome to our third devlog as we venture into the mesmerizing realm of Phrygian. Prepare to be enchanted by the haunting allure of this desert landscape, where mystery and power converge in the shifting sands.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/3c5ff0e230ccb20151f8c102cc93607bae6a0ea0.png[/img]
Our creative journey begins once again with the interpretation of a musical mode. We've embraced the mystical melodies of the phrygian mode, resonating with the stifling and sorrowful essence of this desert environment 🎶


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/fd8970585c2253fd8b01663d9b65b32253d608ae.png[/img]
The landscape of Phrygian is characterized by its windswept rock formations, undulating sand dunes, and vast expanses of cracked earth. Relentless desert winds whip up swirling sandstorms, casting an oppressive orange haze over the biome. The mysterious ambiance of the desert exudes an enigmatic allure, evoking feelings of both sadness and strength. As you traverse the endless dunes and winding canyons, you'll embark on a journey filled with uncertainty and wonder ✨


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/385e7ccdced57dfff5ab6bd5a971c83872959079.png[/img]
Amidst this harsh environment, the flora of Phrygian stands resilient. Sharp, angular plants reminiscent of succulents and cacti thrive in the arid landscape, their elegant yet rugged forms adding to the otherworldly atmosphere of the desert 🌵


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/6dfa217e2e599f038eb184d1e874749611b5e37a.png[/img]
Phrygian's color palette reflects the warm hues of the desert, with ochre yellows, deep purples, and sandy tones dominating the landscape. The setting sun bathes the desert in a soft, golden light, casting long shadows and adding to the ethereal beauty of the environment ☀️


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/5e5fc2c26255395e94158864297f2cedccc09bec.png[/img]
In the midst of this desolate beauty, the remnants of a forgotten civilization emerge, serving as silent witnesses to the passage of time. Weathered ruins and crumbling structures speak of a once-proud people, now lost to the sands of time ⏳

Keep your ears open for upcoming updates as we continue our journey to unravel the secrets of A Last Song.

Before we bid farewell, it’s time to uncover the answer to our last blind test. The melody was [spoiler]The Imperial March from Star Wars[/spoiler].

Now here’s our latest blind test!

[previewyoutube=SUPpQHHE0tc;full][/previewyoutube]

Until next time, meloamis!

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Dorian
notes.notes:
Welcome back, Meloamis! 🤖
We journey deeper into the heart of Dorian in our second devlog. A region where power and humility intertwine, creating an epic ambiance of nature and mystery.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/27e547653f5284210f380c4709b55394c43826b2.png[/img]
As said before in the last one, our creative process for each level begins with a musical mode. In crafting Dorian's musical backdrop, we've chosen the Dorian mode to evoke a sense of epicness, resonating with the towering landscapes. 🎶


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/84767087c087ee4941036d2dc31203d2c72c1a94.png[/img]
Dorian's forest is the true heart of this region, with its majestic trees that seem to come alive. 
Dorian's landscape, inspired by the grandeur of Canadian forests, Norse biomes, and the mystique of Brocéliande, showcases towering elements, making our robot protagonist appear small amidst basalt columns and towering trees. The flora, with its gracefully elongated plants, and the dark, wet slate-like rocks contribute to the awe-inspiring ambiance inspired by the Icelandic terrain. 🌱


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/4adcdf00e9745c209d12da48036e5cf09fe1a9a1.png[/img]
The color palette of Dorian reflects a late summer day - lush forest greens, vivid blues and purples, and bright yellow-greens, all tinged with a cool undertone. As the sun filters through storm clouds, it casts an ethereal glow, illuminating the environment in a play of light and shadow. 🌓


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/b6c7dd527d6b71827088af90e3fee8644ec68558.png[/img]
In the remnants of a human survivor camp, echoes from a bygone era reveal an epic testament to time's relentless decay. The once-sturdy metal bunker, now draped in moss and succumbing to natural erosion, serves as a poignant reminder of humanity's humility in the face of the enduring march of time. ⏳


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/b3fec2f50d5983d32949d84231a701d3484b5a70.png[/img]
With its epic melodies, imposing landscapes, and a harmonious blend of power and humility, the Dorian establishes the perfect atmosphere to prepare yourself to face the game's first boss. 👾

Stay tuned for the unfolding chapters of our adventure, where we explore the secrets of the world of A Last Song. 

Before saying goodbye, let's unveil the solution to our last blind test. The mysterious melody was [spoiler]Tetris[/spoiler]!
Now, brace yourselves for a new challenge in our latest blind test.

[previewyoutube=FRN5gwfvQgQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Until next time, meloamis!

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Ionian
notes.notes:
Hello Meloamis! 🤖

Welcome to the first entry of our new devlog series, where we invite you to the vibrant world of A Last Song. 
Since it’s the first entry we’ll begin with the first region you encounter in game: the Ionian.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/64a1b1c79bd3b6918f610d7c94dbcc15e19a6519.png[/img]
Our creative process for each level begins with a musical mode. Without going into too much detail, you can organize music using 7 different musical modes (Ionian, Phrygian, Lydian, Mixolydian, Aeolian, Locrian). 🎶


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/887645076667ec1ffa5e9f64b74edd002777801a.png[/img]
For each musical mode, we chose emotions that would represent them to give us a focus for the visuals. And the Ionian theme we found revolves around innocence, and naive happiness. 🌻


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/17806cacda716d0854d99d1766f945601d342945.png[/img]
Beneath a midday sun, the Ionian showcases flowery clearings and streams flowing between the rocks, inspired by the beautiful mountainous French countryside. 🍃


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/d17940c19aae4b43c8b435b832da3c19ccf105e1.png[/img]
The surroundings are pastel tones evoking the essence of spring, featuring hues of pink, green and yellow. ✨Pure serotonin✨


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42255611/24abf01b9672ea66a46a0f8cf9ec10f0a9d1e31b.png[/img]
With its calming ambiance, vivid colors and lush flora, the Ionian serves as the perfect starting point for your adventure. 🌱

Embark on this journey with us as we unravel the mysteries and wonders of A Last Song. The Ionian region is just the beginning, and we can't wait to share the diverse and captivating regions you will encounter as you play the game.


In the meantime here is a bonus challenge ! It’s a musical blind test in video. Give us your guess of what song it is and we’ll share the correct answer in the next devlog.

We realise it’s been a minute since we had a big announcement but that’s because we have been deep in development ahead of Paris Games Week! We are very excited to be among the official selection for  [url=https://www.jeuxmadeinfrance.fr/index.php/jeux/]Jeux made in France[/url] alongside some legendary studios and other amazing indie developers.

If you have never been to Paris Games Week, the trailer below shows you how massive it is and how much of an honour it is to be involved! It runs from 1st to 5th November at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, It covers everything from native French indie studios to massive global releases. If you are there, come and find us in Pavilion JMF53.

[url=https://youtu.be/vbSPg3X9wZU?si=6U8D1rXQAdIWxYIm]Paris Games Week trailer[/url]

If not, Paul Samuelson, one of Anomalie Studio’s inspirational founders, will be interviewed on stage at 2pm with hiuuugs and pepipin and you can watch the broadcast live on Twitch [url=https://www.twitch.tv/hiuuugs]Twitch Hiuuugs[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/pepipin]Twitch Pepipin[/url]. He’ll be talking about the creation of the game.

À bientôt
Anomalie Studio

Our new demo just landed with the Steam Next Fest!
